core:map_length_autosome_female.source: Kong A et al. (2002), Nat Genet 31:241-247, table 1: female autosomal map 4281 cM, over 8 segments

core:map_length_autosome_male.source: Kong A et al. (2002), Nat Genet 31:241-247, table 1: male autosomal map 2590 cM, over 8 segments

core:map_length_x_female.source: Kong A et al. (2002), Nat Genet 31:241-247, table 1: X chromosome 179 cM in women
core:map_length_x_female.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 2.2 (K2.2c); the X of a man does not recombine in the model

core:mutation_rate.source: game value; real loss-of-function rates per gene about 1e-6 to 1e-4 (Kong A et al. 2012, Nature 488:471; Jobling MA 2012, Investig Genet 3:5)
core:mutation_rate.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 2.4 (K2.4a, C7): high enough that new mutations show in a run of 200 years

core:mutation_rate_disease.source: game value at the low end of real per-gene rates
core:mutation_rate_disease.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 2.4 and 3.3 (K2.4b): keeps rare disease alleles from coming mostly from new mutations
